rules.alternatives: No general CE hours for APRN renewal until 2028: only the pain management and cultural competency trainings apply. From January 1, 2028, APRN renewal applicants must show national certification or 75 hours of CE related to their advanced practice role.

topics.who: All LPN, RN and APRN renewal applicants; course from the Oregon Pain Management Commission, completed within the last 36 months
All LPN, RN and APRN renewal applicants; within the past 48 months (Oregon Health Authority CCCE list)

rules.notes: Since January 1, 2026 practice hours are no longer required; competency is shown through CE. Reinstatement after 90+ days expired needs 20-60 CE hours depending on how long the license lapsed.
rules.rule_quote: APRN applicants will need to provide evidence of national certification or 75 hours of continuing education related to their advanced practice role.
